info.title: Comic Vine API
info.description: The generated client sets `api_key` and `format=json` through its auth provider. Unofficial OpenAPI description derived from https://comicvine.gamespot.com/api/documentation. The docs give field names but not types, so types are inferred; most scalar fields are nullable strings. Live behavior: an unknown detail id returns HTTP 200 with status_code 101 and an empty results array, while an invalid key returns HTTP 401. Detail-URL type prefixes (e.g. 4005 for character) are not in the docs but were verified against the live API (video_type and video_category use plain ids). Comic Vine requires a descriptive User-Agent header.
